response.overview: Set in a remote resort in Sabah, the story begins when Aina (Amylia Aidura), Erin (Ariana Yusof), Maya (Chacha Maembong) and Julia (Arena Wan) join a 'Spiritual Healing Program' led by Ustazah Ayuni (Fasha Sandha). Armed with hopes of finding peace and improving their individual lives, they are instead welcomed by various strange occurrences. Under the guidance and character of Ustazah Ayuni, who appears to be so calm and pious, various soul purification practices are carried out. However, mysterious disturbances, unexplained disappearances and the discovery of dark secrets begin to haunt them. Gradually, what happens at the resort raises questions about the true intentions behind the program. In seeking answers, Aina also faces past trauma that still haunts her. What initially seemed like mystical disturbances ultimately leads to a far greater question about the true cause of all the events that occur.
response.title: Puteri Kembang Malam
